meta.model: five-driver multidriver.py (LOS-anchored drainage), CMC + Sobol, 4 x 2**12 points per elevation
meta.event: a road point exceeds the SMP 6-inch tolerance in a year (annual maximum); p_* columns are the street's low point (10th percentile of its samples), flooded_mi_* the expected flooded length; ranked by flooded_mi 2050 intermediate

monroe_plan_9.6M_per_mile.source: Florida Specifier, 2023-03-04, Monroe County roads plan: '$1.6 billion, at a cost of $9.6 million/mile'

twin_lakes_23.9M_per_mile.source: Keys Weekly, 2024-08-22: '$21 million resilient Twin Lakes roads pilot project' ... '4,633 linear feet of road' (all-in, incl. drainage)

meta.caveat: Probabilities rest on flagged, unmeasured assumptions (README_multidriver.md); a ranking tool, not a forecast. Centreline lidar sits above gutters, so low points are understated.
